summary.text: RINGSAKER VEGG- OG TAKELEMENTER AS is a private limited company registered in Moelv, founded 2001-10-05. RINGSAKER VEGG- OG TAKELEMENTER AS sells, designs, produces and installs lightweight wall and roof constructions and related products. It was previously named RINGSAKER TAKELEMENTER AS until 2017-10-24. Its main industry code is 16.230: manufacture of other builders' carpentry and joinery. The register shows 98 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 138 238 342 NOK and the annual result was -23 110 974 NOK; operating income was up from 96 540 742 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -29 733 298 NOK in 2024 to -23 110 974 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 2 629 083 NOK in 2024 to -13 141 024 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Mona Ørbekk (daglig leder) and Per-Olof Schrewelius (styrets leder), with 1 other board member. Its verified website is rvt.no, which links to its LinkedIn profile. The latest news on its own website is "Fra tegnebrett til fabrikkhall: Slik sikrer RVT byggbare visjoner" from 2026-05-04. The registered employee count went from 84 on 2025-11-13 to 98 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
